contradictions.what: Rep first said Maya made the final call, then admitted Greg decided whether anyone was chosen.
Rep thought we were only keeping the incumbent honest, yet signing came four days after the data session.
Deal is described as won, but covers memberships only; front desks remain with Global and phase two is undated.
Rep says 'a third' with 'don't quote me' yet attributes the figure to Maya's board deck.
